intro.title: Build end to end test harness for core routes
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build an end-to-end test harness to verify that the core routes of your Node.js application work correctly from start to finish. You'll learn how to use the Supertest library to simulate HTTP requests and make assertions on the responses from your Express server. The main technologies involved are Node.js, the Express framework, and the Mocha test runner with Chai for assertions. By the end, you'll have a set of automated tests that check your routes return the expected status codes and data, helping you catch bugs early.
intro.usecase: End-to-end test harnesses are essential for validating critical user workflows in production applications. For example, e-commerce platforms use them to test the complete checkout flow—from adding items to cart through payment processing and order confirmation. Financial dashboards rely on these tests to ensure data visualization and transaction reporting work correctly across all integrated services. API-driven applications test authentication flows and data persistence to prevent regressions in user-facing functionality.
